tier1.text: Through its branches, each deep femoral artery supplies blood to the deep muscles of the thigh and parts of the skin. Each deep femoral artery branches off the femoral artery, which runs from the groin down the leg. The branches of each deep femoral artery include the lateral circumflex arteries.
